about: The critic's regression fixtures (SNAP-R108, R109): pictures the operator judged by eye, run blind through the snap-critic skill. Pictures live in a local fixtures folder (README.md); this manifest names them relative to it.
scoring: Positive: an expected flaw counts as caught when the critique names the same flaw (same physical/logical problem) AND locates it (region words). Negative: a false alarm is any note at medium or high severity that is not real, or a real but minor item (allowed_true_minor) rated high. Notes on allowed_true_minor items at low/medium are fine; a must_not_flag item flagged at any severity is a false alarm. Auto-scoring matches each expected flaw's keys (every group must match a note's text, any severity) and lists every medium or high note on a clean picture for a hand check; --confirm settles the rows it marks '?'.
